explanation: cos(theta*) = 1.3 is not a valid cosine magnitude (must be in [-1, 1]). The EXCLURAD preflight check FAILS this point: 'cos(theta*) = 1.3 is not a cosine (|cos| > 1); the request is ill-posed.' Do not clamp — a cosine value >1 has no corresponding physical polar angle, so no valid kinematic point exists. The user must supply cos(theta*) in [-0.999, 0.999] (EXCLURAD avoids exactly ±1.0 due to the polar-angle pole in the integration measure). W=1.7 GeV (>1.4861 threshold) and Q2=1.0 GeV^2 are otherwise fine.
